programs.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programs.desc: In Dumfries, Simon O'Brien and Henry Cole meet Mary, who's retired and is planning to downsize, and uncover a horse trap and a broken one-arm bandit.

programs.title: Help! We Bought a Village
programs.desc: Owners of a French village host the local council at their restaurant. A couple spend their first Christmas in their hamlet. The first guests arrive at a Spanish cave village.

programs.title: Countdown
programs.desc: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Lucy Porter in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.

programs.title: A Place in the Sun
programs.desc: Retirees Steve and Jackie want a Spanish holiday home in Guardamar del Segura to enjoy with their family and friends. Lee Juggurnauth shows them what £80k can buy.

programs.title: Escape to Florida
programs.desc: In Groveland, Laura prepares for a wedding ceremony, but heat and horses cause problems. Singer Sarah turns her Orlando living room into a cabaret club.
